content: To create a microchaptered page, follow these detailed instructions: How to Search for the Page You Want to Create 1. Begin by searching for the disease name of the page you intend to create. This ensures that the page does not already exist. 2. Additionally, search for synonyms or alternative names of the disease to avoid duplicating content. 3. If the page already exists but is not microchaptered, you can create a new microchaptered page for the disease and reorganize the existing content into the new format. 4. Only microchapter a page if it exceeds one and a half pages in length and contains sufficient content to be divided into microchapters. 5. To microchapter a page, follow the instructions below to create a microchapter template. Then, copy and paste the reorganized information into the standardized microchapter format. How to Create a Microchapter Template 1. If the disease page does not exist, you will need to create a new microchaptered page. For example, if you are creating a page on jaundice that does not exist: a. Navigate to the WikiDoc Disease Microchapter Template page. b. Click on the edit source tab and copy all the text in the edit box. c. In the main WikiDoc search box, type Template:Jaundice (without quotation marks). d. Click on the option that says Create the page Template:Jaundice on this Wiki. e. Click on the edit source tab and paste all the microchapter template information into the edit box. 2. At the top of the edit box, you will see two blank boxes: The top box has binocular icons next to it. Enter type page name here. The bottom box has red arrows next to it. Enter the name of the disease page you are creating. 3. Click on the red arrows on the right side of the bottom box and continue clicking until you reach the end of the edit box. This action will populate the disease name in all the microchapter navigation boxes, linking them to the appropriate pages. 4. Remove any cells that are not relevant to the disease you are working on. 5. Click save at the bottom of the edit box. 6. You now have a microchapter navigation template that can be inserted into all the microchapter pages you create. How to Create the Microchaptered Home Page 1. Search for the disease name in the WikiDoc search box. It is advisable to search for synonyms of the disease name to ensure no similar page already exists. If a similar page exists, you can add new content or incorporate the old content into a new page. For example, for jaundice, search for Jaundice and click on Create the page Jaundice on this Wiki. 2. In the edit box, type `{{Jaundice}}`. 3. Click save at the bottom of the edit box. The main page will now display the microchapters listed on the right side of the main page. 4. Use the microchapter template in all subsequent microchapter pages you create by typing `{{jaundice}}` into the edit box. This ensures ease of navigation, as users can easily click back to the home page or other microchapter pages regardless of which microchapter page they are viewing. 5. The home page should also contain links to the individual microchapter pages in the appropriate order. To do this, type into the edit box of the home page: `==[ ]==`. On the left side of the vertical line in the brackets, include the link to the page. On the right side, specify how the link should appear on the page. For example, the main page might display Historical Perspective. 6. Use the template found on the WikiDoc Disease Microchapter Template page. Copy all the template information in the edit box and paste it into the home page of the microchapter you are creating. 7. Remove links that are not relevant to the disease you are creating. 8. Ensure that the links on the home page match and are in the same order as the cells in the microchapter navigation template. 9. Maintain consistency in capitalization and nomenclature. For reference, click on the provided example to ensure proper formatting. How to Create the Individual Pages Within a Microchaptered Page 1. The home page will display the microchapter navigation template on the right side of the screen and the headings of the microchapters in the middle section of the page. These headings will also link to the microchapters. 2. To view an example of this on a home page and practice navigating a microchaptered page, click on the provided example link. 3. As you create new microchapter pages, add a link to the home page. 4. To create a new microchapter page: Click on the appropriate section within the microchapter navigation template on the home page. Click on Create the page _____ on this wiki. Use the appropriate template listed on the main page to create the page. Include the microchapter navigation template `{{jaundice}}` on each microchapter page. References and Sources 1. If the content for the page is obtained from a general source, such as a website or textbook, list it under a heading at the bottom of the page titled Sources. 2. If the content is obtained from a journal article or another article, list it under a heading at the bottom of the page titled References.
